title: Making AI-Generated Feedback Matter: From Provision to Student Enactment
abstract: arXiv:2608.11625v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Feedback processes strongly influence student learning, yet their educational value depends on addressing two distinct challenges: providing high-quality, timely, and individualised feedback at scale, and supporting students to interpret, evaluate, and act on that feedback productively. Generative AI offers a credible means of addressing the provision challenge, but students' uptake of AI-generated feedback remains limited. We conducted a large-scale quasi-experimental sequential cohort study comparing three AI-mediated feedback workflows across 13,037 students and 51,296 student-authored resources. In Directed Feedback (n = 3,723), students received AI-generated feedback comments without structured support. In Self-Directed Feedback (n = 3,951), students could initiate optional AI-supported dialogue. translated_title: 让AI生成的反馈发挥作用：从提供到学生实施
translated_abstract: 反馈过程对学生的学习有显著影响，但其教育价值取决于解决两个不同的挑战：大规模提供高质量、及时且个性化的反馈，以及支持学生有效解读、评估并采纳这些反馈。生成式AI为应对提供反馈的挑战提供了可靠的手段，但学生对AI生成反馈的采纳仍然有限。我们进行了一项大规模准实验性序列队列研究，比较了三种AI介导的反馈工作流程，涉及13,037名学生和51,296份学生创作的资源。在定向反馈组（n = 3,723）中，学生收到AI生成的反馈评论，但没有结构化支持。在自我导向反馈组（n = 3,951）中，学生可以发起可选的AI支持对话。在实施反馈组（n = 5,363）中，学生被提示选择反馈建议、评估其相关性，并参与针对性的AI互动。
tldr: 本研究通过大规模实验发现，当学生被引导选择、评估并实施AI生成的反馈时，反馈的教育价值显著提升，而单纯的提供或可选对话效果有限。
en_tdlr: This study found through large-scale experiments that educational value of AI-generated feedback significantly improves when students are guided to select, evaluate, and enact the feedback, whereas mere provision or optional dialogue has limited effects.
